quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 half-year report (DART, filed 2026-08-13, consolidated, KRW): Q2 (April-June 2026) revenue KRW 30,798M vs KRW 6,806M a year ago (+352% YoY; Q1 2026 was KRW 20,738M, so +49% QoQ) with operating profit KRW 10,360M (33.6% margin) vs KRW 1,037M and net income KRW 10,724M vs KRW 1,314M. H1 2026 revenue KRW 51,537M (+346% YoY vs KRW 11,555M) - already above FY2025 full-year revenue of KRW 50,778M - operating profit KRW 15,246M (29.6% margin) vs KRW 1,329M, net income KRW 16,636M vs KRW 1,409M; basic EPS KRW 701 (split-adjusted). Gross margin 38.7% (H1 gross profit KRW 19,923M). Segment H1: ATE / test-handler division revenue KRW 46,715M (90.6% of sales, +409% YoY vs KRW 9,171M) with operating profit KRW 14,882M (31.9% margin, 97.6% of group OP); MAI odd-form component inserter division KRW 4,822M (9.4%, +102% YoY vs KRW 2,384M), OP KRW 365M. Product mix: test handlers (main model M500HT) KRW 46,715M; MAI inserters (MAI-H6T) KRW 4,822M; average selling price per ATE set rose to KRW 612M from KRW 528M in FY2025. Geography H1: Korea KRW 11,466M (22%), Asia KRW 39,490M (77%; handler exports to Asia KRW 38,110M vs KRW 3,756M a year ago), Europe KRW 145M, US KRW 436M; exports KRW 40,071M = 78% of sales. Separate (parent) basis: revenue KRW 50,340M, OP KRW 14,998M, net income KRW 16,359M. Balance sheet 2026-06-30: cash KRW 11,433M plus KRW 5,000M time deposits, borrowings KRW 18,950M (Shinhan Bank KRW 15,950M at 3.38-4.20%, Hana Bank KRW 3,000M at 3.67%), equity KRW 146,127M, accumulated deficit of KRW 66,170M offset against capital surplus in H1 so retained earnings turned positive at KRW 20,463M; operating cash flow KRW 13,162M. Tax rate 0% for FY2026 on loss carry-forwards. FY2025 reference: revenue KRW 50,778M / OP KRW 9,143M / net income KRW 10,112M; FY2024: KRW 27,042M / KRW 12,121M. Filing narrative: post-2025 generative-AI spread is lifting HBM, GPU and advanced-packaging demand and semiconductor makers' capex, re-shaping the test-handler market toward high-speed high-precision tools; China self-sufficiency investment also active.

quarterly_data.signal: Customer concentration H1 2026 (customers above 10% of consolidated sales): YILINING PRECISION KRW 19,595M (38.92% of sales, handlers; Q2 alone KRW 11,609M), UNIMOS MICROELECTRONICS (SHANGHAI) CO., LTD. KRW 13,978M (27.77%, handlers; Q2 alone KRW 12,420M) and SK Hynix KRW 10,020M (19.91%: handlers KRW 7,961M plus KRW 2,059M of MAI equipment; Q2 handler sales to SK Hynix KRW 3,165M). A year earlier SK Hynix was the only above-10% customer at KRW 4,269M. Top-3 customers = 86.6% of H1 sales; the two Chinese OSAT/trading customers appeared in H1 2026 and drove the export jump. The company does not report an order backlog (orders arrive continuously, revenue recognised on delivery, 40% cash at contract / 30% at delivery / 30% after), but section XI lists 15 disclosed single-sale supply contracts for semiconductor inspection equipment signed 2025-11-26 to 2026-06-23 totalling KRW 87,666M: YILING TRADING 6 contracts KRW 49,363M (2025-11-26 KRW 13,851M delivered, being inspected; 2026-03-12 KRW 6,192M partly delivered KRW 4,754M; 2026-03-20 KRW 3,847M delivered; 2026-04-29 KRW 3,831M, 2026-06-01 KRW 15,423M and 2026-06-23 KRW 6,220M in preparation, terms 70% before shipment / 30% after final approval, deliveries through 2026-12-15); Unimos Microelectronics (Wuhan) 4 contracts KRW 23,186M (2025-12-19 KRW 10,200M and 2026-02-26 KRW 3,303M delivered; 2026-03-12 KRW 1,689M delivered awaiting payment; 2026-05-12 KRW 7,994M in preparation, to 2026-10-30; terms 90% within 30 days of arrival / 10% after final approval); SK Hynix 3 contracts KRW 8,835M (2026-03-17 KRW 2,240M fully paid; two contracts of 2026-05-19 for KRW 3,957M and KRW 2,638M in preparation, delivery to 2026-10-30, 90% on delivery / 10% on acceptance); Yangtze Memory Technologies 2 contracts KRW 6,282M (2026-05-26 KRW 3,576M to 2027-07-01 and 2026-06-12 KRW 2,706M to 2026-08-31, payment within 60 days of final approval, in preparation). Roughly KRW 49.5B of these contracts (the 9 undelivered or partly delivered ones) had not yet been recognised as revenue at 2026-06-30. Supporting balance-sheet evidence: customer advances (contract liabilities) KRW 10,491M at 2026-06-30 vs KRW 1,561M at 2025-12-31; inventory KRW 52,666M vs KRW 34,639M (work in process KRW 26,212M, raw materials KRW 15,122M, finished goods KRW 10,420M) = 26.5% of assets; trade payables KRW 17,265M vs KRW 8,271M. Trade receivables KRW 15,712M gross with allowance cut to KRW 1,692M (10.8%) from KRW 3,063M as collections improved.

quarterly_data.signal: Capacity and capex: standard capacity 15 test-handler sets per month and 15 MAI sets per month at the Cheonan plant (filing table shows H1 2026 capacity 48 test-handler sets and 90 MAI sets vs 96 / 180 for full-year 2025); H1 2026 production 139 test-handler sets worth KRW 56,507M - already 1.5x the 90 sets (KRW 36,306M) built in all of FY2025 - and 12 MAI sets (KRW 1,486M); utilisation 97.5% (936 of 960 available hours) in both divisions; equipment is designed in-house and final-assembled and tested on site with some assemblies outsourced (outsourced processing cost KRW 1,261M in H1 vs KRW 506M). Plant expansion: board approved on 2026-06-29 the purchase of land and buildings in Eumbong-myeon, Asan, Chungnam for KRW 14,500M as a new factory site for business expansion, balance paid 2026-07-29; construction in progress KRW 1,614M at 2026-06-30 includes KRW 1,477M of deposits for that site; machinery purchases KRW 482M in H1; PP&E KRW 19,050M vs KRW 16,994M. Board also approved a collateralised real-estate loan on 2026-06-29 and a credit loan on 2026-06-08; short-term borrowings rose to KRW 12,450M from KRW 7,450M (new KRW 5,000M Shinhan loan at 4.2%). Raw materials: H1 purchases KRW 44,599M (handler parts KRW 36,379M = 82%, mounter parts KRW 8,220M = 18%) sourced as small lots of many part types from several hundred mostly domestic vendors, none related to the company, with no procurement difficulty reported; unit-price trend for handler assemblies broadly flat to up (chamber mechanical assembly KRW 57,112K, main electric assembly KRW 21,377K, main/gantry/chamber frame KRW 13,480K vs KRW 12,610K in 2025). Raw-material usage KRW 27,963M in H1 vs KRW 7,136M a year ago. Headcount 119 (113 men, 6 women). Related-party purchases from parent Nextern & Roll Korea KRW 404M and from subsidiary Aron Tech KRW 2,738M (parent basis).
quarterly_data.figure: H1 output 139 handler sets (KRW 56.5B) vs 90 sets in all of FY2025; utilisation 97.5%; capacity 15 handlers/month; new Asan plant site KRW 14.5B approved 2026-06-29; raw-material buys KRW 44.6B

quarterly_data.signal: Products and R&D: ATE line-up covers memory, module, logic, in-socket and burn-in load/sort test handlers supporting QFP/BGA/CSP/MLF packages and up to 1,024-parallel testing; development record 2021 MH5 and MA16 handlers, 2022 ML16, 2023 MH7 new chamber and MARS-T, 2024 MARS-C, +150 C chamber and MHEX-08S chiller, 2025 M500HTS handler (current main brand M500HT), 2026 MM32 module handler. R&D spend H1 KRW 1,469M = 2.92% of sales (FY2025 6.37%); 146 patents (115 ATE, 31 MAI), 12 trademarks. Domestic test-handler competitors named: JT, Techwing, AMT and Advantest; MAI competitors Hanwha Techwin, Juki, Yamaha, Panasonic, Fuji. Corporate events: (1) 5-for-1 stock split (par KRW 500 to KRW 100) approved at the 2026-06-24 EGM, effective 2026-07-09, shares outstanding 5,090,828 to 25,454,140; (2) third-party placement to parent Nextern & Roll Korea of 608,174 shares at KRW 11,181 (KRW 6,800M, paid 2026-04-09, lock-up to 2027-04-30) lifting its stake from 32.31% to 40.40%; second placement to affiliate Roa&Co Holdings of 2,324,538 post-split shares at KRW 2,237 (KRW 5,199M) paid 2026-07-27, listing 2026-08-14; (3) acquisition of control of KOSDAQ-listed Atlaslink (formerly Alois, broadcast equipment; H1 2026 revenue KRW 34,154M, OP KRW 6,104M) - share and management-rights transfer agreement 2026-06-08, 16.63% (5,756,352 shares) bought for KRW 9,210M in H1, remaining 20.21% (6,994,990 shares, KRW 11,192M) closed 2026-07-09 for a 36.84% stake and KRW 20,402M total, consolidated as a subsidiary, stated purpose external growth and technology-development collaboration; (4) the KRW 14,555M stake in the Daishin-Y2HC new-technology fund reclassified as held for sale after the fund exercised its put on CHA Biotech convertible preferred shares on 2026-08-03 (sale window 2026-08-13 to 08-18, interim distribution 2026-08-31); (5) former Teradyne memory-division president Young Cheol Kim elected independent director 2026-03-27; CEO Lee Chang-jae re-elected. Share price rose from a KRW 12,160 January low to KRW 60,300 at 2026-06-30 (H1 TSR 321.97%). Subsidiaries: Suzhou Mirae Automation Technology (China sales, H1 revenue KRW 1,578M), Aron Tech (Korea, parts manufacturing, KRW 2,738M), Mirae SPC (investment), Mirae Corporation Vina (Vietnam service). No dividend policy in force. Auditor Jeongin review opinion unqualified.
